directive.quote: Restore truthful existing workspace.rs port contract using verified515aa baseline/d94 policy identity, preserving later81b public aliases.
directive.source: Authorized coordinator assignment in the existing L101 owner case; not a new person message.

preserve: The existing WorkspaceAssets owner pins the complete regular-file tree and manifest, verifies referenced files, and rereads exact pinned bytes rather than arbitrary filesystem data.
The existing public-program admission queue remains separate from private current-session and operation admission.
Static GET and HEAD responses retain exact byte lengths, target MIME, bounded response lifetime, and immutable caching only for versioned addresses.
The existing supplied shell, first-answer streaming, nonce policy and current account/live ownership remain in the same adapter.
allowed_deltas: The pinned manifest's optional public_assets map names canonical root-file aliases for exact pinned workspace/named targets; the generic adapter contains no product asset catalogue.
Validate alias names, target paths, physical tree collisions and exact references when opening the manifest. Stable aliases retain no-cache while their content-named targets retain immutable caching.
Move the duplicated public-program classification into its existing owner and add standard ICO MIME support; private routes and undeclared aliases still require current-session admission.

Retain the shared checkout's existing formatting and response-custody changes as whole source bytes; this contract does not claim that this lane authored them or that it published their caller adapters.
banned_substitutions: An invented missing-prior-owner claim, new source owner, retired Worker restoration or hardcoded product icon catalogue.
A post-policy self-source presented as the original baseline, an archival copy supplying active retention, or a claim that local source checks establish installed or customer behavior.
Weaker path confinement, pin checks, current private admission, response bounds or retention thresholds.

baseline.source_state: Metadata restored after implementation. The baseline is the real pre-policy in-place Rust snapshot, not a copy newly manufactured by this lane. This path first appears at 515aa4aff6a8a8007c2ce9464521694701b66df7.

proof.qualification: The exact source tree passed all four new public-assets tests and the normal all-target build. The whole working-folder workspace suite reported 24 pass, zero failures and one preexisting ignored retained-frontend test. No installation or public release is claimed.

observed_port_judge.qualification: The actual shared port judge read this contract from the current repository and the target from the exact committed range. Its current meaningfulLines spelling trims physical lines; the retained whole source has substantial preexisting formatting changes. The threshold, source and target bytes were not changed to make this check pass.
